issues.description: The UML/problem statement defines Farm.animals as a private attribute ('- animals: List<Animal>') and explicitly asks students to implement a getter and setter. The solution implementation declares the animals field as public (public List<Animal> animals;), which contradicts the UML visibility and the guidance to use accessors. This could confuse students about the intended encapsulation and the necessity of getter/setter methods.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the animals field private in the solution (private List<Animal> animals;) to match the UML and problem description, and access it via the provided getAnimals() and setAnimals() methods. Update any direct references to the animals field to use the accessor methods where appropriate.
